item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00276","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C16","C19","C03"],"selected_candidate_label":"C16","confidence":0.9,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C16 plausibly supplied material drafting machinery for the child. Both directives preserve previously issued orders, regulations, rulings, or licenses concerning Treasury-administered controls, keep them in force, and authorize a named successor official to amend, modify, or revoke them. The child adapts that concrete continuation mechanism to the Gold Regulations and the Secretary of the Treasury. C19 provides a related savings clause for prior actions, proceedings, penalties, and forfeitures, while C03 closely parallels the continue-until-amended-or-revoked formula, but neither matches as much of the child's combined administrative machinery as C16.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"All licenses, orders, rules, or regulations heretofore issued under [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] ... shall continue in full force and effect until amended, modified, or revoked by the Secretary of the Treasury.","parent_excerpt":"all orders, regulations, rulings, instructions, or licenses issued by the Secretary of the Treasury ... shall continue in full force and effect except as amended, modified, or revoked by the Attorney General.","explanation":"Distinctive parallel preservation mechanism covering nearly identical categories of administrative instruments, coupled with authority in a named official to amend, modify, or revoke them."},{"child_excerpt":"This amendment ... shall not affect any act done, or any right accruing or accrued or any suit or proceeding had or commenced ... and all penalties, forfeitures, and liabilities ... shall continue and may be enforced as if this amendment had not been made.","parent_excerpt":"No person affected by any order, regulation, ruling, instruction, license, or other action ... may challenge the validity thereof or otherwise excuse his actions, or failure to act, on the ground that ... such ... action was within the jurisdiction of the Attorney General rather than the Secretary of the Treasury or vice versa.","explanation":"Both protect the continuing legal effect and enforceability of actions taken under the prior Treasury-centered regulatory regime, although the child's savings language is broader and more explicit."}]}
